title: Immersive Linear Algebra Book with Interactive Figures (2015)
summary: An interactive linear algebra textbook launched in 2015, featuring embedded interactive figures that allow readers to manipulate mathematical concepts visually rather than just reading static equations.
problem_solved: Makes abstract linear algebra concepts more intuitive and accessible through visual/interactive learning experiences.
why_valuable: Transforms traditionally difficult mathematical concepts into explorable, hands-on experiences that improve understanding and retention.
